preamble: In Mandarin, Middle Chinese velar initials were palatalized to [tɕ] before the high front vowels and glides [i, y] (the 'jiàn' series). For originally voiced [g] the oblique tones give unaspirated [tɕ], after the general devoicing of the voiced series.
sources: Pulleyblank, E. G. (1984). Middle Chinese: A Study in Historical Phonology. University of British Columbia Press.
Norman, J. (1988). Chinese. Cambridge University Press.
